pteridinium: All eight final r003 individual512px frames personally opened. Hero/reversehero/front/rear are very low oblique/side views and obscure most cavity depth; do not claim every feature visible in every view. Physical relief stronger than r001, palette subordinate. Three-vane height/posture and display orientation interpretive; original fossil-specimen scope retained, not a complete living organism.
